name: Ahishahar
overview: Ahishahar was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Bilhan. His mention in Scripture is brief and centers on his genealogical placement within the tribe. There are no additional notes or details about his life recorded in the biblical text.
namesAndTitles: The name Ahishahar means '[my] brother was born at early dawn,' reflecting a Hebrew origin and possibly indicating a familial or hopeful significance at birth. This is the only recorded name for him, and it was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Ahishahar is explicitly recorded as the son of Bilhan, establishing his immediate paternal lineage. Beyond this relationship, Scripture does not provide further family connections or descendants for Ahishahar.
scriptureSignificance: Ahishahar's significance lies primarily in his role within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin. His mention in 1 Chronicles 7:10 helps preserve the lineage and tribal identity important for understanding the broader narrative of Israel's history. While he does not appear in other biblical events, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of biblical record-keeping and the importance of family heritage in God's plan.
